I crept downstairs, and made myself a pot of coffee. Not in the same way it had before, of course. The switch didn't flick, the machine didn't turn itself on, but I found a can of instant coffee and poured it into hot water. The machine didn't even make that familiar, almost comforting, noise of grinding coffee beans. It wasn't the same.

Then again, nothing was the same.

The clock was dark, the hour hand at 12. No wonder - nothing ran at the same time anymore
